June, I can't set up that recurring 17:30 post. I have no way to schedule a repeating job from here, so the "Pod end of day" note wouldn't go out on its own. I don't want to say it's set up when it isn't.

What I can do is post the note whenever someone asks me in #strategic-pod. I'd list that day's new messages from the channel. If you'd like it each weekday, ask me at about 17:30 and I'll post it then. Or an admin could set up a scheduled job for it, and I can help with that.
